name: Oji-san to Asobou
source:
One day, Azusa, a very popular influencer with 50,000 followers, received a DM from an old man! How would you reply to him...?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6610]Official site[/url]]
translation:
某天，擁有五萬粉絲的人氣網紅梓，收到了一位大叔發來的私訊！換作是你，會怎麼回覆呢……？

[譯自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6610]官網[/url]]
